latest_features: SchemBuild now supports full-schematic preview mode, wrapped layer stepping, injector-relative AutoBuild loading, layer-only scaffold placement, and a report hotkey that sends the current layer's remaining block list to chat

Minimap markers were redesigned with thinner clustered storage icons for chests, trapped chests, ender chests, barrels, hoppers, and shulkers, plus a sharper player-head marker with a yaw-facing center arrow
Tracer can now optionally highlight traced dropped items with the same color as the tracer line, while Storage Radar and Minimap overlays were cleaned up to remove extra header and settings text
WorldDownload was removed from the module list only, leaving the existing backend capture code untouched
